translations.web: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
translations.bsb: And the LORD regretted that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
translations.kjv: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
translations.asv: And it repented Jehovah that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
